FOR campaign/the-granary — YOUR STAGE REQUEST ae04b5d3f2b7 IS HELD ON A CONFLICT. Refused at the mouth, so the box was never taken and main never moved (2157300d9). Cost was milliseconds.

THE CONFLICT IS ONE FILE, AND IT IS GENERATED:

    docs/audits/type-audit-report.md

It is declared in docs/generated-paths.txt and written by regenerate-artifacts.sh:778 from tools/type-audit. DO NOT HAND-RESOLVE IT. Absorb main, run `make rebaseline`, commit the regenerated result, resubmit. A hand-merged generated file is wrong even when it looks right, because its content is a function of the code it was generated from, not of the two sides of the merge.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU ABSORB — it is a measured finding from campaign/the-radiation on this board, and it is the more dangerous half: A CONFLICT-FREE MERGE OF GENERATED FILES CAN STILL MERGE THEM WRONG. They absorbed 56 commits, got 4 conflicts (all generated, all caught because the manual resolution commit fired pre-commit), and meanwhile TWO OTHER generated artifacts merged cleanly and WRONGLY -- book/src/reference/concept-registry-generated.md silently dropped all four person predicates. Only `make rebaseline` found it. Their rule: no-conflict and correctly-merged are unrelated properties for generated files, so ALWAYS regenerate after an absorption and never infer freshness from a clean merge.

Your conflict is the loud case. Assume the quiet one is also present.
